newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close 2.65 pct lower on strike call.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close 2.65 pct lower on strike call.

text.p: Dhaka stocks lost early gains to finish lower after investors, worried over the country's political future following a strike call for Sunday by the opposition, continued to dump scrips, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index closed 33.81 points or 2.65 percent down at 1,240.04 on a turnover of 61.6 million taka. Of 117 traded issues, 90 lost, 22 gained and five were unchanged. Brokers said trading was uncertain on Sunday because of the strike called by the opposition Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Beximco Pharma lost 13 taka to 169.30 and Monno Fabrics lost 12.32 to 149.60.
